teaser: Exploring offers to license a book that started on Leanpub: who takes such books, examples from before, and the questions to ask.
core_idea: Technical publishers have taken books that began on Leanpub or as free editions, Leanpub leaves the rights with the author under a non-exclusive licence, so the right answer to a licensing offer is a limited licence that keeps the open, updated Leanpub edition, with clear scope, term and reversion.

quotes.text: For this book, the answer I would like to reach with any publisher is a licence, not a sale
an open or early edition did not stop a publisher; in several cases it is why the publisher came.
